program.description: VIC karakterkeszlet valtasa (nagybetu/kisbetu). LDA $D018 + ORA/AND + STA generalas, 8 byte.

program.commentText: TEXT auto-detects lowercase: a-z=scr 1-26, A-Z=scr 65-90 when input has ANY lowercase letter
program.operand: TEXT auto: lowercase input → mixed case encoding
program.rawOperand: TEXT auto: lowercase input → mixed case encoding

payload.expertText:
* = $0801

.clear_screen

.set_border $00
.set_bg $00

.print "WHAT'S YOUR NAME? "
.repeat
    JSR $FFE4
    .if A = #$0D
        JMP done
    .endif
    JSR $FFD2
.until A = #$0D
done:
.end
